name: smwsprites-smb3-statue-laser
title: SMB3 Statue Laser
description:
This shooter will shoot a long stream of laser, much like the ones in SMB3 Bowser's castle statues.

The neat thing about this shooter is that it uses cluster sprites, so the laser stream is able to cover more than the half of the screen vertically. It also evaporates any sprite on contact.

The sprite is incompatible with other cluster sprites (boo ceiling, boo ring, etc).
